company.shortDescription: Beond is a premium leisure airline that provides unique and personalized experiences for today's modern travelers.
company.description: Beond is a premium leisure airline that provides unique and personalized experiences for today's modern travelers. Beond will launch flights from a number of places using the most recent aviation and luxury travel advances. The airline focuses on redefining leisure travel by combining comfort, exclusivity, and convenience for modern travelers seeking a refined and relaxing journey. The airline combines comfort, elegance, and personalized hospitality through spacious lie-flat seats, gourmet cuisine, priority airport services, and curated in-flight experiences. beOnd focuses on transforming air travel into a seamless and relaxing journey, offering modern travelers greater convenience, exclusivity, and exceptional service from departure to arrival.
